objective: Audit the eligible exposed-development population and triage reusable compatibility barriers without analyzer changes or reserved discovery.

scope.population_definition: The complete set of pinned application revisions already named by the D2 exposed-development allowlist and supported by tracked pairing evidence: one WarpToad revision and the Payy earlier/check-added pair.
scope.historical_reports_permitted_use: Aggregate only already published attempt counts, stopping reasons, build outcomes, and limitations. Do not copy reserved identities or infer family lineage.
scope.synthetic_controls: Repository-authored controls are inventoried separately and are not counted as ecosystem projects or independent families.
scope.selection_limit: This is a bounded exposed-development census, not an estimate of the wider Noir/EVM ecosystem. Zero observed unavailable, ineligible, or build-failed candidates is not a prevalence estimate.

compatibility_status_taxonomy.UNAVAILABLE: The approved target identity is known but its source, pinned revision, or required artifact evidence is inaccessible. This is not a build failure.
compatibility_status_taxonomy.INELIGIBLE: The target is outside the frozen Noir/ACIR producer to Solidity/EVM consumer scope or lacks the required proof-to-execution boundary.
compatibility_status_taxonomy.BUILD_FAILED: An eligible approved target was attempted but no usable producer and consumer build route was obtained. A failed default route with a successful scoped route is not BUILD_FAILED.
compatibility_status_taxonomy.UNSUPPORTED: Source/artifacts are available and sufficiently built, but analysis stops fail-closed at a named compiler/schema, semantic opcode, memory, verifier-mapping, or consumer-extraction gate.
compatibility_status_taxonomy.ANALYZABLE: The approved target has usable producer/consumer evidence and the current interface completes the requested analysis far enough to emit supported facts or warnings. ANALYZABLE is not a safety verdict.

counting_units.candidate_revision: One pinned application revision with a producer/consumer pairing. This is the primary eligible-population unit.
counting_units.repository: One upstream source repository; multiple revisions do not create multiple repositories.
counting_units.architectural_lineage: A code and proof/consumer architecture lineage. Shared authorship alone is insufficient.
counting_units.target_variant: One authored benchmark mutation. Variants are not projects, revisions, or independent families.
counting_units.analysis_attempt: One frozen invocation against one project at one analyzer version. Reattempts count again here but not as new projects.
counting_units.unique_project: One project identity across attempts. This is not an adjudicated family count.
counting_units.blocker_occurrence: The first fail-closed stopping category for one analysis attempt unless explicitly marked as a nested contributor.

eligible_population.status_count_interpretation: Counts cover only the three allowlisted pinned revision candidates. They exclude mutants, synthetic controls, and historical transfer attempts.

historical_transfer_reconciliation.family_count_limit: No code/architectural lineage adjudication exists for these eight projects. The latest project distribution therefore cannot be converted into affected-family counts or used as a family-ranked ecosystem estimate.

blocker_distribution_and_ranking.ranking_rule: Rank current exposed-development barriers first by affected architectural lineages, then by affected target variants, while reporting implementation risk separately. Historical rows with null family counts are not inserted into this family ranking.

current_development_ranking.risk_basis: Requires supported compiler-AST boundary selection and relation extraction while preserving fail-closed ambiguity handling. The Payy subset also has an upstream artifact-specific mapping precondition.
A mapping must be derived and certified for each mutated artifact; reusing either exact pinned Payy certificate would be unsound.
current_development_ranking.counting_note: Nested contributor to the 12 Payy cases already counted under the named consumer-AST first stop; do not add these 12 again.

historical_risk_context_not_family_ranke.reason: MultiScalarMul and RecursiveAggregation require sound semantic treatment, not schema-only acceptance.
beta.3 and beta.25 represent distinct format/version work; a generic new frontend is not evidenced to unlock successful analysis.
The observed beta.21 MemoryOp encoding difference still requires semantics-preserving decoding and tests.
Multiple verifier boundaries require explicit selection or multi-boundary modeling rather than a heuristic choice.

bounded_compatibility_recommendation: Preserve the current fail-closed gates and use the two exact application lineages plus the authored controls as anchors; do not relabel unsupported as misses or safe targets.

For current development coverage, specify and test the consumer-AST relation route at the exact unsupported shapes. Before treating the 12 Payy mutants as analyzable, derive an artifact-bound recursive mapping certificate per mutant and reject certificate/artifact hash mismatch.
Treat improving 12 Payy variants as depth within one lineage, not ecosystem breadth. Do not claim that this work adds 12 projects or families.

Do not select beta.3, beta.25, MemoryOp, MultiScalarMul, or RecursiveAggregation work from the historical project counts alone. A custodian would need to provide allowed redacted lineage metadata before those rows can support affected-family ranking.
No universal family threshold or new-frontend success claim is justified. Revisit compatibility priorities after Gate A or after an approved lineage-aware population expansion.
claim_limits: The three-candidate census is constructed from already exposed development inputs; it does not measure the wider ecosystem or unbiased discovery.
Two repositories and two architectural lineages are represented. The two Payy revisions are one lineage, and authored mutants/controls are not independent families.
The 12 historical attempts are 8 unique projects with 4 repeats and no adjudicated independent family count. Their project blocker distribution is not a family distribution.
ANALYZABLE, no-warning, and repair-control outcomes are not security verdicts. All research conclusions remain UNKNOWN unless separately supported under the research contract.
No analyzer, source, rule, protocol label, reserved identity, or private artifact was changed or inspected for this inventory.
